title: Containers and applications
name: Name
externalHint: Use the original Compose file to change this project. Its containers remain visible here.
composeHint: Paste YAML/JSON or open a Compose file. Use published images and absolute host paths. Existing project files are preserved before an edit.
portsHint: Host:container/protocol, one per line. Host address defaults to all interfaces. Example: 8080:80/tcp. Empty: publish the image’s declared ports over TCP and UDP using the same host port.
installHint: Install only the missing packages from configured system repositories. Existing Docker installations and data are preserved.
dataHint: Images, containers and named volumes are stored here. Choose a dedicated folder on a persistent local data filesystem.
moveHint: Running containers will be stopped during the copy and started afterwards. The original directory is preserved. Bind-mounted folders outside Docker data are not moved.
recoverHint: An interrupted transfer needs recovery. Original data is preserved. Recovery starts Docker from the authoritative location and restores previously running containers.
removeHint: Application removal stops its containers and removes its project network. Named volumes and host folders are preserved. A volume deletion permanently deletes its data.
stopHint: Its services will be temporarily unavailable.
invalidPorts: Use host:container/tcp or host:container/udp, with ports from 1 to 65535.
lastKnown: Connection lost. Displaying last known state.
phase.copy: Copying Docker data; original files are preserved
phase.start: Starting Docker at the new location
volumeWarning: All data in this named volume will be permanently deleted.
containerWarning: The stopped container and its writable layer will be removed. Volumes and host folders are preserved.
resourceWarning: The selected unused Docker resource will be removed. Resources in use cannot be removed.
applicationWarning: Containers and the project network will be removed. Named volumes and host folders are preserved.
imageSearchHint: Type an application name, e.g. nginx or postgres: Docker Hub search starts after 2 characters. Or enter a full image address, e.g. ghcr.io/owner/image:tag. After selecting a result, you can append :tag; without a tag Docker uses latest.
imageSearchError: Search is unavailable. Retry or enter an exact image address.
imageSearchResults: Docker Hub results — select an image
imageSearchEmpty: No images found. Try another name or enter an exact image address.
imagePullHint: Downloads the image to the NAS. This does not create or start a container.
tagHint: latest is a moving tag, not a fixed version. Choose a version to download.
tagsError: Could not load tags. Enter the required tag manually.
localImageHint: Only downloaded images can be used. Download new images in Images first.
metadataHint: Defaults come from the image. Check its documentation for required settings and credentials.
webHint: Choose only if this port serves a web interface.
anonymousVolumeHint: Declared image volumes without a NAS folder use Docker-managed anonymous volumes. Other unmapped paths remain in the container.
invalidConfiguration: Check compatibility, port ranges, unique variable names and volume paths.
statsStopped: Resource metrics are available while the container is running.
configureHint: Applying changes may recreate the container. Mounted data is preserved.
discardHint: Your unsaved settings will be lost.
memoryUnavailable: Docker did not provide memory accounting data.
coreUpdateRequired: Update PaNasMs to the latest version to use this module.
